translations.web: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
translations.bsb: Which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?
translations.kjv: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish
translations.asv: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doth not first sit down and count the cost, whether he have wherewith to complete it?
